intro: The Hunter's Path is a vital milestone for young tauren hunters in Mulgore, directing them toward advanced training in beast companionship. Dispatched by their local mentors once their basic marksmanship and tracking are proven, novices are sent to Bloodhoof Village to seek the counsel of hunter trainer Yaw Sharpmane. This journey initiates the spiritual and practical trials required to tame and bond with wild beasts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
You must see Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I do believe you are ready...
